name: design
description: Value-to-architecture workflow with parallel security, quality, and operations challenge

tasks.prompt: Interactively impossible in headless mode: build complete SPEC-TS Scope, prioritized Product Requirements and measurable Success Metrics from evidence. Return NEEDS_INPUT/BLOCK on decision-critical gaps. Include value, owner, baseline, guardrails and human gates. Objective: {{objective}}

Complete SPEC-TS Engineering Constraints, Components and technical Trade-offs. Produce Design Pass 1 with 2-3 materially different options, score fixed rubric, select provisional candidate and define Gate 1 evidence. Inputs: {{dependencies}}
Passively threat-model and challenge provisional design. Do not run active techniques. Confirm reachable design risks and required controls. Architecture: {{dependencies}}
Perform design-phase STORY READY/BLOCKED review: trace outcomes, acceptance, NFRs, evidence plan, dependencies, rollout and rollback. No release tuple exists yet. Architecture: {{dependencies}}
Challenge operability: SLOs, telemetry, alerts, capacity, recovery, deployment safety, support, cost and toil. This is design evidence, not launch approval. Architecture: {{dependencies}}

Perform Design Pass 2 and verify Gate 1/Gate 2: adversarially challenge candidate, integrate specialist evidence, resolve contradictions, keep unresolved work BLOCKED, and produce SPEC-TS ledger, proposed ADRs, READY/BLOCKED stories, Success Metrics and human gates. Do not vote. Inputs: {{dependencies}}
